svg.title: Carmine v4 message queue lifecycle
svg.desc: A message has at most one active generation. It moves between absent, scheduled, ready, and leased. Coalescing may store one latest successor. A retained dead generation is an independent historical role.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: RETAINED DEAD GENERATION · independent historical role

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
remove active generation;
promote successor if present

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
dead-redrive!
only when no active exists

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LEASED FAILURE
outcome:dead or exhaustion policy :dead

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RETAINED DEAD
payload + bounded failure summary

REPLACE ACTIVE
remains ready or scheduled

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LATEST SUCCESSOR
at most one · may have its own delay

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PROMOTE AFTER
terminal settle, exhaustion,
or successor-aware release

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
READY OR SCHEDULED
according to successor delay

SCHEDULED
future or overdue until maintenance

span.p:
READY
high · normal · low
FIFO within each band

span.p:
LEASED
attempt incremented · fenced token
current or expired until maintenance

FINISH ACTIVE
ack · discard · dead · exhausted
